reason: As a working magician I'd actually use tricks like these, and 99 ₪ is nothing for me. But it's a browser-installed app that wants my card on its own website, and I don't type my card into sites I've never heard of. I'd play with the free tricks and stop there.
objection: It's not in the App Store or Google Play, so nobody vetted it. If they take my card and it breaks after the next iOS update, or the 'lifetime' site disappears, I have no one to complain to.
would_change_my_mind: Selling it through the App Store or Google Play, or at least paying with Apple Pay / Google Pay / PayPal, so I'm covered if it's a scam.
